summary:
Stage 12 test: Smarter Tactic fit, official app pages, Formula starter pack, first-run setup redesign. Setup was done in the UI (TEST_Career / TEST Club, FM26), then 2 more saves were read (3 in total). New pytest file test_fmcc_stage12_fit_starter_apps.py passes 14/14, plus a limit test. Stage 11 regression passes 35/35 after 2 asserts were updated for the new fmOS spec (kind 'web' to 'windows'). UI tested with Playwright at 1920 and 390 with no page errors.

Working:
- Setup: logo 150px, title 44-68px, step cards 62px high, card 1080px wide. At 1920, FM26/FM27 and Find share a vertical center (788.8px). Find label follows the edition ('Find FM26'). Clicking Find shows 'Found FM26 ✓', then Continue > Skip > career/club > Skip > Health check > Open FMCC goes to Home. No horizontal scroll at 1920 or 390.
- Tactic fit 433 and 4231: no unique_id repeats across starter, backup and depth, and every pick is natural. The starters' rating sum equals an exhaustive search (the assignment is truly optimal). 11 slots, 3 gaps, 404 for an unknown formation. /squad/shapes returns 200.
- Starter pack: GET lists 10 formulas with all fields, and all 10 preview fine. POST adds only the missing ones (a second call only added goal_threat). Unknown keys are ignored, an empty list gives 422. Added formulas show in /scout/formulas, /scout/meta and the Players rows f{}. Edit adds a revision and delete brings back 'not added'. UI: the pack card shows 'n/10 added'. Try fills key, name and expr with a live preview without saving. Add shows the Added badge. Add all reaches 10/10 and disables itself. Edit, save and delete from the list work, and the Add button comes back.
- /api/apps: fmst26 and fmos urls are correct and all 3 are kind windows. The Connections 'Official page' links (app-get-*) have the right hrefs and target=_blank.
- Settings > Updates: FMST26 v2.1.0, fmOS v1.5 and FM Dossier v1.15.3 show 'You update it yourself' with a Download page link and no Update now button.
- Regression: all 13 Scout tabs switch cleanly. The advanced filter cuts 100 rows to 40 and shows '(on)'. The quadrant has 4 zones with a formula perf. The Formulas (9) column group shows. The guided tour runs to the end and sets fmcc-tour-done.

minor.issue: Not atomic near the 30 limit. With 28 formulas and 4 keys sent, it saves 2 and then returns 409 'You already have 30 formulas'. The UI shows only an error toast even though 2 were added. Cap the list to the free slots first, or return {added, skipped:'limit'} with 200.

Revisions are append-only per key, so re-adding a starter formula after deleting it shows 'version 6'. The 'version 2 after edit' only holds the first time. Consider restarting the visible version after a delete, or label it as history.

ui_bugs.issue: The FM26/FM27 selector and the Find button wrap onto two lines on mobile (seg y=667, Find y=734). They are on one line at 1920. The fixed sizes are 94+93+16+160 = 363px, wider than the ~306px card content box. Shrink the seg padding or button padding under 760px if one line is wanted on mobile too.
Try on an already-added formula puts its key in the editor. Saving then silently overwrites the user's edited version with the pack default.

issues: The sample has two different players called 'Luca Romano' (uid 20481105 and 20481106), so a name shows twice (CB backups 65 and 56). This is correct data, but users can't tell them apart: show age or a short id next to the name.
'Cost per grade point' shows a raw number (232759) instead of money format
The 'Formulas (0)' toggle label is stale until meta loads
The 'not tracked' text after the app name reads like a status. Use '—' or leave it out.

action_items: Make POST /scout/formulas/starter respect the limit without a partial save plus 409 (cap the keys to the free slots and report the skipped ones)
Optional: keep the setup edition selector and Find on one line at 390px
Optional: tell same-name players apart in the Tactic fit cards, money-format the cost formulas, fix -0.00
critical_code_review_comments: lab_api._layer: the cost matrix adds n+len(slots) columns with dummy cost 0, and ineligible players cost 10000. Correct, but every layer re-runs an O(n^2 m) Hungarian. Fine for 23 to 40 players, but a big squad (60+) times 3 layers times the formations in /squad/shapes could be slow.
add_starter calls the route function save_formula directly. Each call rebuilds _ctx (scout data plus attach), which is heavy for Add all. Build it once.

fit(): 'all' in the response is still every player's rating (natural first), which is fine. But the score uses top[0..2] weights, so a slot with no natural depth scores low even when the squad is small by design.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows work; only the mobile one-line layout for the setup selector is missing)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Career / TEST Club through the setup UI, 3 saves, starter-pack formulas, test_lim_* formulas, TEST_ tactics and app paths during the stage11 rerun. All cleaned up: deleted by career_id from audit, identities, league_estimates, pools, formulas, stat_history, snapshots and tactics, plus the career itself, the 3 backups whose reason starts with 'TEST_Career:', settings.app_paths, and /app/backend/preview_fm (made during the session). settings.setup_complete=false; /api/state confirms setup_complete false and career null. The components collection (9) is untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=...; pytest tests/test_fmcc_stage12_fit_starter_apps.py tests/test_fmcc_stage11_lab.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. You need a career with 3 saves first: do setup in the UI or POST /api/setup/complete, then POST /api/saves/read {} twice. The stage12 optimal test reads the latest snapshot from Mongo and brute-forces the assignment. The update-version test depends on the live pages (v2.1.0, v1.5, v1.15.3) and will need changing when those apps release. The sample data has two different 'Luca Romano' players. Set localStorage fmcc-tour-done=1 before navigating in Playwright.
rca of the issue: Starter limit partial save: add_starter loops and calls save_formula, which raises HTTPException(409) when len(fs) >= 30 after earlier inserts were already made. Setup wrap at 390: .wiz-row has flex-wrap:wrap with fixed button sizes (seg buttons 46px high and 26px padding, btn-l 28px padding), wider than the mobile card's content box.
